description: This is a test class for the EmpEmergencyContactService in the OrangeHRM application. It contains unit tests for the service methods related to employee emergency contacts, including retrieval, saving, deletion, and searching of emergency contact data.

classes.name: EmpEmergencyContactServiceTest
classes.description: Unit test class for EmpEmergencyContactService, testing its methods related to employee emergency contacts.

methods.description: Initializes the test environment and populates fixture data.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeEmergencyContact
methods.description: Tests retrieving a single emergency contact for an employee.

methods.name: testSaveEmpEmergencyContact
methods.description: Tests saving a new emergency contact for an employee.

methods.name: testDeleteEmployeeEmergencyContacts
methods.description: Tests deletion of emergency contacts for an employee.
